title: The extended cochain complex of a faithfully flat ring map is exact
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that for a faithfully flat ring map R to A and any R-module M the extended cochain complex, that is the complex obtained by putting M in degree minus one in front of the complex of the cosimplicial module associated to A over R, is exact (statement lines 773-779). The proof first reduces to a smaller problem: it suffices to find a faithfully flat ring map R to R' such that the statement holds for R' to R' tensor A, because the cosimplicial module computing the bigger complex is obtained from the smaller one by tensoring with R', and faithful flatness of R to R' lets the vanishing of cohomology descend (proof lines 781-793). The author marks the parallel treatment of the two extra degrees of the extended complex as omitted, which is why the proof is shorter than the statement suggests. The reduction is then discharged by the cheapest possible choice, namely R' equals A, since the ring map A to A tensor A over R has a section given by multiplication and the section case has already been handled (proof lines 795-800). The claim is H2: the reduction step is a real argument in which the two cosimplicial modules are identified and faithful flatness is used to descend the vanishing, and the choice of the cover is then justified by exhibiting the section.
